title: ExceptionInInitializerError: Using same DLL in 2 Different Product flavor released App on same system running at same time
body:
### Steps to Reproduce

1. Add File picker dependency
2. use 2 or more product flavor in your app
3. use both app with different product flavor on 1 system at same time

### Expected Behavior

normally run both apps

### Actual Behavior

got exception:

java.lang.ExceptionInInitializerError
